blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday inspected the newly constructed Felipe Abrigo Memorial Hospital (FAMH) in Guiuan, Eastern Samar, which was rebuilt after being damaged by Typhoon Yolanda in 2013.
